ios.desc:
KUDOS isn’t a productivity app or to-do list. It’s a personalized framework that helps you to stay on top of the choices you make throughout your day. Kudos was designed to help you be more aware of and accountable to your daily choices and how *you* frame habits & rewards.

CELEBRATE PROGRESS in a flexible and encouraging way.

BUILD MOMENTUM at your own pace.

Celebrate every small step with POSITIVITY and PERSONALIZED REWARDS.

---

KUDOS IS DESIGNED BY
AND FOR NEURODIVERGENT PEOPLE

Kudos is especially helpful for neurodivergent users, ADHD and AuDHD brains, folks with Pathological Demand Avoidance (aka Persistent Drive for Autonomy), and anyone who feels boxed in by rigid systems and routines that don’t accommodate their needs and style.

DESIGNED FOR ACCESSIBILITY
Kudos was designed with options for size, font, color, sound, and support for iOS accessibility features. 
Kudos includes the Open Dyslexic font, accessible themes, and custom UI options to fit your specific needs.

DESIGNED FOR REAL BRAINS
Because habit tracking should support how your brain works, not how someone else thinks it should.

Whether you experience executive dysfunction, demand avoidance, or need more accessible tools, Kudos helps you create change with flexibility, personalization, and compassion.

FLEXIBLE & LOW PRESSURE
Kudos is designed to be quick, intuitive, and forgiving. It adapts to your natural way of thinking and working – rather than forcing you into a rigid system – making it easier to stay engaged. 

MOMENTUM > SHAME
Kudos is not built to guilt or shame you into change. Instead, it emphasizes mindfulness, positive reinforcement, and self-kindness – supporting your growth in a way that feels sustainable and encouraging.

---

KUDOS IS DIFFERENT:
• Complete a habit to earn points
• Redeem rewards that actually mean something to you
• Assign point values to habits and rewards based on what they’re worth to you
• Choose how well you did
    - Best effort
    - Good try
    - Missed habit (that’s okay!)
• No due dates
• No shame, just honesty & accountability
• Leave gentle reminders for your future self after a missed habit
• Access a growing set of themes, sounds, and fonts, including options for color blindness and a dyslexia-friendly font
• View your Kudos Score, track streaks and stats, and reflect on your growth
• Home screen widgets, Apple Watch support, and reminder notifications help you remain accountable to your goals wherever you are

---

TRY KUDOS FOR FRE

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built a app to help neurodivergent brains form better habits

quotes.text:
Hey HN!
Story time:

A friend of mine who I've known since childhood has adult diagnoses for autism + adhd. He's a business owner and has always struggled with creating and maintaining healthy habits both in his personal and professional life. Those of you with adhd will get it: He knows what habits he wants and needs to form, but the executive function disorder often prevents him from being able to initiate and follow through on them. The autism side of his brain adds a whole extra layer of complexity. Through therapy and a lot of personal research, he's learned techniques to manage this in small doses but has always had difficulty maintaining those habits for more than brief periods of time.

As a fun little side project, I created an app to help him maintain the habits he struggles with based on techniques that we've seen actually work for him in the past. It was meant to be a simple tool that he'd be motivated to use regularly, and it worked! It worked so well that we decided to polish up this little side project and publish it for others to use.

We figured, if it worked so well for him, it'll probably work for others with similar neurodivergent brains for whom more traditional habit forming apps just aren't effective enough.

- The website is linked in the title.

- It's on the iOS App Store here: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kudos-habits/id6746104744?platform=iphone

Questions and feedback are welcome!
